merger_name: Investissement Québec, Fonds de solidarité des travailleurs et des travailleuses du Québec and Placement Louis Bibeau Inc. – Australian Defence Apparel

merger_description:
9571-9241 Québec Inc., a Canadian holding company based in Québec, proposes to acquire 100% of the shares in Logistik Unicorp Holdings Inc. (**Logistik**), a Canadian company based in Quebec, and, indirectly, of all of the issued and outstanding shares of the share capital of its Australian subsidiary, Australian Defence Apparel Pty Ltd (**Australian Defence Apparel**) (the **Acquisition**).

The Acquisition involves WC Capital Holdings LP and Placement Louis Bibeau Inc. (**Placement LB**) selling their interests in Logistik to the 9571-9241 Québec Inc., with Placement LB acquiring an interest in the 9571-9241 Québec Inc.as part of the Acquisition.

Following completion, Investissement Québec (**IQ**), Fonds de solidarité des travailleurs et des travailleuses du Québec (**FTQ**) and Placement LB will hold 30%, 35% and 35%, respectively, of the issued and outstanding shares of the share capital in 9571-9241 Québec Inc.and, indirectly, in Logistik and in turn Australian Defence Apparel.

Logistik is a special purpose holding vehicle for the Logistik business, a specialised clothing business based in Quebec, with operations in, among other places, Canada, Australia and New Zealand.

Australian Defence Apparel is the operating company in Australia of the Logistik business. Australian Defence Apparel is involved in the design, manufacture and distribution of specialised clothing, ballistic vests and load carriage equipment to military, law enforcement and first responders.

IQ is a Québec government owned corporation formed under the laws of Québec, established for the purposes of supporting the province's economic development.

FTQ is a public labour sponsored fund formed under Québec laws, established for the purposes of developing a capital investment network in Québec, Canada.

Both IQ and FTQ are Québec-based financial sponsors which seek to invest in, and support the growth of, Québec companies.

Placement LB is principally a holding company formed under the laws of Canada, currently controlled by the founder of the Logistik business, Louis Bibeau.

events.title: Notification waiver determination published

determination_table_content.details:
In making this notification waiver determination, the Australian
Competition and Consumer Commission (the ACCC) has considered
the information provided with the notification waiver application and
had regard to the factors in section 51ABV(2)(b) of the Competition
and Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) (the Act).
Based on the information provided in the application, the ACCC
considers that the Acquisition is unlikely to give rise to any material
lessening of competition, given there is no horizontal overlap or
vertical relationship between IQ, FTQ or Placement LB (or their
controlled entities) and Australian Defence Apparel in Australia.
In these circumstances, the ACCC considers it is not necessary to
reach a concluded view on whether the notification thresholds are
likely to have been met.
Given that material competition concerns are unlikely to arise, the
ACCC has determined that the Acquisition is not required to be
notified.
The ACCC considers that the determination is consistent with the
object of the Act and the interests of consumers in promoting
competition.
For more information about the ACCC’s approach to considering
notification waiver applications and to assessing competition
effects more generally, see the ACCC’s guidance on notification
waivers and merger assessment guidelines.
